<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>In this paper we study the main characteristics of some evaluation codes parameterized by the edges of a bipartite graph with a perfect matching.</jats:p>
title: Codes parameterized by the edges of a bipartite graph with a perfect matching
